178.csv::296.source_text:
珍しい素材が取れる洞窟を教えてやる――
バシアスから、あんたにどうしても
教えてやってくれと頼まれてな
178.csv::296.translated_text:
There&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s a cave yields rare raw materials—
Bacias made me promise to tell you.
178.csv::296.speaker: Randolf

178.csv::297.source_text:
ウルテカ山岳は火山の影響もあって
とても自然豊かとは言えないが
この洞窟の中は別だ――様々な素材が取れる
178.csv::297.translated_text:
Urteca Mountains... volcanic influence means
nature&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s scarce up there.
But inside this cave&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s different—yields all
manner of raw materials.
178.csv::297.speaker: Randolf

178.csv::298.source_text:
地図にマークを付けておいてやるから
中の様子を見てくるといい――
魔物がウヨウヨいるから、準備だけは怠るなよ
178.csv::298.translated_text:
I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ll mark it on the map for
you—go see what&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s inside.
Crawling with monsters in there, so don&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;t you
skimp on preparations, eh?
178.csv::298.speaker: Randolf

178.csv::299.source_text:
それと最後に――洞窟が今
どうなっているかだけは教えてくれ
しばらく様子を見に行けていなくてな
それ以外は好きにやってもらってかまわん
178.csv::299.translated_text:
One last thing. Just make note how the cave
is doing. I haven&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;t been able to check on it for
a while. Other than that, do as you like.
178.csv::299.speaker: Randolf

178.csv::300.source_text:
地図にマークを付けておいてやるから
中の様子を見てくるといい――
魔物がウヨウヨいるから、準備だけは怠るなよ
178.csv::300.translated_text:
I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ll mark it on the map for

you—go see what&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s inside.

Crawling with monsters in there, so don&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;t you

skimp on preparations, eh?
178.csv::300.speaker: Randolf

178.csv::301.source_text:
ふん、無事に戻ってきたようだな
で――中の様子はどうだった？
178.csv::301.translated_text:
Hmm, you made it back in one piece.
So, how was it inside?
178.csv::301.speaker: Randolf

178.csv::302.source_text:
なるほどな――心配していたほど
悪いようにはなっていないようだ
178.csv::302.translated_text: I see—ain&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;t as bad as I feared, eh?
178.csv::302.speaker: Randolf

178.csv::303.source_text:
今後も好きに活用してくれ
お前が出入りするようになれば
自然と魔物も減っていくだろうさ
178.csv::303.translated_text:
Feel free to make use of it henceforth.
If you frequent there, the monsters&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27; presence
will naturally decrease.
178.csv::303.speaker: Randolf

178.csv::313.source_text:
覚者殿、こんな話を耳にされたことはございませんか？
《聖炎の参竜道》には隠されし宝と
それを守る3匹の魔物がいる――という話です
178.csv::313.translated_text:
Master Arisen, has such a tale
e&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;er reached your ears?
They say the Sacred Flame Path conceals a hidden
treasure, watched o&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;er by three
monsters—or so the story goes.
178.csv::313.speaker: Youssef

178.csv::314.source_text:
実は私、こういう話に目がないもので
子供のように胸が躍ってしまうのです
確かめてみたい気持ちはあるのですが
いかんせん場所が場所ですから――
178.csv::314.translated_text:
Verily, I confess a weakness for tales such as
these — my heart races like a youngling&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s at the
mere prospect. I should dearly like to verify the
matter for myself, yet... the
location being what it is...
178.csv::314.speaker: Youssef

178.csv::315.source_text:
覚者殿、折り入ってお願いがございます
どうか《聖炎の参竜道》の宝の真相を
調査してきてはいただけないでしょうか？
178.csv::315.translated_text:
Master Arisen, I have a favor to ask. Would you
be so kind as to investigate the true nature of
the riches of the Sacred Flame Path?
178.csv::315.speaker: Youssef

178.csv::316.source_text:
《聖炎の参竜道》には隠されし宝と
それを守る3匹の魔物がいる――という話です
この話が本当であれば、危険な調査になるでしょう
くれぐれもお気をつけて
178.csv::316.translated_text:
The Sacred Flame Path is said to hold a hidden
treasure, guarded by three monsters — or so the
tale goes. Should that tale prove true, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;twill be
a perilous investigation. Pray,
take the utmost care.
178.csv::316.speaker: Youssef

178.csv::317.source_text:
覚者様、お戻りになられましたか
ご無事でなによりです――
それで、宝の真相はどうだったのでしょう？
178.csv::317.translated_text:
Ser Arisen, you have returned, I see— Truly, it
is a relief to find you unharmed.
Now then... what verity did you uncover
regarding the treasure?
178.csv::317.speaker: Youssef

178.csv::318.source_text:
おお、本当に宝はあったのですね
それにそれを守る3匹の魔物も――
なんとロマン溢れる話なのでしょう！
178.csv::318.translated_text:
Ah, so the treasure truly did exist...
And the three monsters that stood guard o&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;er it,
as well— What a tale brimming with
romance this proves to be!
178.csv::318.speaker: Youssef

178.csv::319.source_text:
いつか、私もこの目で見てみたいものです
元はといえば、こういった伝説や英雄譚に憧れて
子供心に兵士を志したもので――
178.csv::319.translated_text:
Someday, I should like to behold
it with my own eyes.
After all, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;twas a youngling&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s longing for
legends and valiant tales that first set me
upon the soldier&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s path—
178.csv::319.speaker: Youssef

178.csv::320.source_text:
お忙しいところ、依頼を引き受けてくださって
ありがとうございました
きっと、今後子供たちが口にする英雄譚の主人公は
覚者殿になることでしょう
178.csv::320.translated_text:
I thank you for accepting this request
despite your many duties.
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;Twill surely be Master Arisen who takes the lead
in the heroic tales children speak of hereafter.
178.csv::320.speaker: Youssef

178.csv::321.source_text:
覚者さま、《初代王の指輪》を手にされたとか！
ご存じですか？
その指輪、アッカーシェランで数百年もの間
誰にも見つけられなかった代物なんですよ
178.csv::321.translated_text:
Master Arisen, word is you&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ve come into
possession of the Ring of the First King!
Did you know? For hundreds of years in Acre
Selund, that ring was a thing no soul could find.
178.csv::321.speaker: Liberation Army Soldier

178.csv::322.source_text:
どれだけの力を秘めているのかは
学も無い自分らにはわかりませんけど――
元貴族であり、クレス前王に仕えていた
キルスティ師ならお詳しいかもしれませんね
178.csv::322.translated_text:
What power it holds, I do not wit—us
unlearned sorts, that is.
But Master Kirsty, once a noble in service to
former Queen Cress...
She may well know more of it.
178.csv::322.speaker: Liberation Army Soldier

178.csv::323.source_text:
えーっと、今では辺鄙な場所にある&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;あばら屋&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;で
暮らしていらっしゃるのだとか
偉い方の考えることは理解できませんや
――王宮には戻られないのですかね
178.csv::323.translated_text:
Well now, I hear tell they&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;re livin&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27; in a
ramshackle hovel out in the back
o&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27; beyond these days.
The thinkin&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27; of the high and mighty is beyond the
likes of me— ...They don&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;t mean to return to the
Royal Palace, I imagine.
178.csv::323.speaker: Liberation Army Soldier

178.csv::324.source_text:
《初代王の指輪》について
詳しくお知りになりたければ
一度尋ねてみてはどうです？
178.csv::324.translated_text:
If you&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;d know more of the Ring of the First
King, why not try asking?
178.csv::324.speaker: Liberation Army Soldier

178.csv::325.source_text:
《初代王の指輪》についてですか？
今はハイセプターのジョブマスターをしている
キルスティ師ならご存じかもしれませんね
メガドシス高地にある、&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;あばら屋&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;にお住まいとか
178.csv::325.translated_text:
The Ring of the First King, is it?
Master Kirsty, now serving as High Scepter Job
Master, might well know of it.
Word has it she dwells in a ramshackle hovel on
the Megadosys Plateau.
178.csv::325.speaker: Liberation Army Soldier

178.csv::326.source_text:
サマラ初代王の指輪？
ああ、アレで火垂れ山への扉を開いたそうだね
あの扉はサマラ初代王に関わる何かが無いと
開くことはないから――例えば、血統や遺品なんかのね
178.csv::326.translated_text:
The Ring of the First King, Samara...?
Ah... so &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;twas with that you opened the door
to Firefall Mountain.
That door will not open without aught tied to
Samara, the First King— Bloodline, or
heirloom, or the like.
178.csv::326.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::327.source_text:
サマラ初代王の指輪は
長年その行方すらわからなかった
私の王――クレス様も
その指輪を探し求め、各地を巡られたものだ
178.csv::327.translated_text:
The Ring of the First King, Samara...
For long years, its very whereabouts were unknown.
My queen—Queen Cress—she sought that ring, and
journeyed far and wide in search of it.
178.csv::327.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::328.source_text:
指輪探しの旅には私も同行したよ
初代王の遺品は、その強すぎる力によって
扱いが難しいとされている――
そこらの兵士に探させるわけにはいかなくてね
178.csv::328.translated_text:
I accompanied Her Majesty on that search for the
ring, as it happens.
The Relics of the First King... their power is
too great, they say— Too dangerous to
commend to common soldiers.
178.csv::328.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::329.source_text:
なに？　クレス様について聞きたいのか？
ならば――そうだな――少し、私の思い出話に
付き合う気はないかい
178.csv::329.translated_text:
What? You wish to hear of Queen Cress?
Then... let me see... Would you indulge my
reminiscences awhile?
178.csv::329.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::330.source_text:
《秘泉への暗道》、そこで話をしよう
君も行ったことがある場所だから
迷うことは無いだろう？
入口で待っていてくれ、私もすぐに向かう
178.csv::330.translated_text:
The Dark Path to the Secret Spring... let us
speak there. &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;Tis a place you&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ve visited before,
so you should not lose your way. Wait at the
entrance — I shall be there anon.
178.csv::330.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::331.source_text:
《秘泉への暗道》で待ち合わせよう
――まさかとは思うが、迷うことは無いね？
君も一度は行っているはずだ
私もすぐに向かうよ
178.csv::331.translated_text:
Let&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s meet at the Dark Path to the Secret Spring.
— I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;d ne&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;er have thought it, but you won&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;t
lose your way, will you?
You&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ve been there once before, after all.
I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ll be along anon.
178.csv::331.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::332.source_text:
この奥にある、ネド王子が秘蹟を行った場所
竜の石像のある泉へ行こう
――誰かと共にダンジョンを進むというのは
かなり久しぶりだな
178.csv::332.translated_text:
The place deeper in where Prince Nedo performed
the secret rite — let us go to the spring with
the dragon stone statue.
... It&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s been a fair while since I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ve pressed
into a dungeon with another.
178.csv::332.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::333.source_text: 前は、クレス様と一緒だった
178.csv::333.translated_text: Ere... I was with Queen Cress.
178.csv::333.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::334.source_text:
クレス様も、ネド王子と同じく
この泉で秘蹟を行われたんだ
その時に護衛したのが私だった
178.csv::334.translated_text:
Queen Cress underwent the secret rite at this
spring, just as Prince Nedo did. &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;Twas I who
stood guard at that time.
178.csv::334.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::335.source_text:
私たちがまだ少女だった頃――
何度か王宮で顔を合わせただけの私を
クレス様はなぜかハイセプターにと指名された
178.csv::335.translated_text:
When we were still girls— Queen Cress named me
High Scepter, though we&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;d only met a few times at
the Royal Palace. Why, I know not.
178.csv::335.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::336.source_text:
私は特に何も思うことなく――
ただの役職としてそれを受け入れ
先代のハイセプターに師事し、技を磨いた
幸いかなり素養もあったみたいでね
178.csv::336.translated_text:
I accepted the position without any particular
thought— studied under the previous High
Scepter, honed my skills.
Fortunately, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;twould seem I had quite
the aptitude for it.
178.csv::336.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::337.source_text:
クレス様が重臣たちの前で
秘蹟を行われた時――輝く泉に照らされた
横顔を見て、初めて自分の務めの重大さを
心から思い知ったものだ
178.csv::337.translated_text:
When Queen Cress performed the secret rite before
the high ministers—her profile illuminated by the
shining spring—I first knew in my heart the
true weight of my duty.
178.csv::337.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::338.source_text:
この方は素晴らしい竜となる覚者で――
そして私を選ばれ、私がお仕えする王なのだと
心の芯が震えるような思いだった
178.csv::338.translated_text:
This one is a magnificent Arisen who shall become
a Dragon—and that they chose me, that they are
the queen I serve... &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;twas a feeling that
shook me to my core.
178.csv::338.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::339.source_text:
さて、今回の思い出話はここまでだ
思い出話なんてのは尽きないものだからね
適当に切り上げないと大変なことになる
さ、私の家に戻ろうか
178.csv::339.translated_text:
Well then, this reminiscing ends here.
Such stories know no cease, you see — we must cut
it short, else &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;twill be quite the trouble.
Come, let us return to my hearth.
178.csv::339.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::340.source_text:
何だい？　私に、老人のように
思い出話ばかりしろって？
残念ながら、そこまで暇じゃないのさ
さ、我があばら屋へ戻ろうか
178.csv::340.translated_text:
What is it? You&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;d have me spin naught but
reminiscences like some doddering elder?
I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;m afraid I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ve not the leisure.
Come, let&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s return to my hovel.
178.csv::340.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::341.source_text:
泉で秘蹟を行ったクレス様は王として
アッカーシェランの繁栄に尽力された
――この話の続きは次の機会にでもとっておこうか
思い出話を聞きたいほど暇なら、またおいで
178.csv::341.translated_text:
Queen Cress, who performed the sacrament at the
spring, devoted herself to Acre Selund&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s
prosperity as its queen... Let us save the rest
for another occasion. If you&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ve leisure enow
for reminiscence... visit again.
178.csv::341.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::342.source_text: おっと、邪魔者が入ったね
178.csv::342.translated_text: Oh my, an unwelcome guest has shown up.
178.csv::342.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::343.source_text: たまにはカッコいいところでも見せようじゃないか
178.csv::343.translated_text:
Let me show you a more gallant side of
me, for once.
178.csv::343.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::344.source_text: 魔道剣はそこらの刃物とは違う――わかっているね？
178.csv::344.translated_text:
A Magick Sword is no common blade — you
understand this, yes?
178.csv::344.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::345.source_text: 敵の生命力を我が物とする――格闘術ではなく、魔術だよ
178.csv::345.translated_text:
The foe&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s vitality becomes ours to claim — not by
martial arts, but by magick.
178.csv::345.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::346.source_text: やれやれ、静かに思い出話もできないなんて
178.csv::346.translated_text: Oh, come on—I can&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;t e&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;en reminisce in peace.
178.csv::346.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::347.source_text:
この前の話の続きを聞きにきたのかい
――そうだな、では今度は《王家の墓》で話をしよう
前回、君と共に戦ったのは
思いのほか楽しかったからね
178.csv::347.translated_text:
Come to hear the rest of our last talk, have you?
—I see. Then let us speak at the Royal Family
Mausoleum this time.
Last time, fighting alongside you...
...proved more pleasant than anticipated.
178.csv::347.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::348.source_text:
歴代のハイセプターたちによって磨かれた技
このまま鈍らせるのも勿体ない
久しぶりにそう思えたんだ
178.csv::348.translated_text:
Skills honed by generations of High Sceptres...
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;Twould be a waste to let them go dull.
First time in a long while I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ve thought as much.
178.csv::348.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::349.source_text:
いいね、《王家の墓》だ
私も軽く準備をしたら
すぐに向かうよ
178.csv::349.translated_text:
Good. The Royal Family Mausoleum, then. I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ll make
light preparations and be thence anon.
178.csv::349.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::350.source_text:
今回は《王家の墓》で話をしよう
まぁ、思い出巡りの旅に
付き合うと思ってくれ
私も軽く準備をしたらすぐに向かうよ
178.csv::350.translated_text:
Let us speak at the Royal Family
Mausoleum this time.
Well... deem it a pilgrimage through memories.
Think of it as keeping an old woman company.
I shall be there anon, once I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ve made ready.
178.csv::350.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::351.source_text:
ん？　気にしないで、私も今来たところさ
では行くとしようか！
――このすぐ先にある小部屋から
不穏な気配がするな、油断は禁物だ
178.csv::351.translated_text:
Hm? Think naught of it — I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ve only
just arrived myself.
Come then, let&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s be off!
... There&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s an ill presence from the small room
just ahead. No room for carelessness.
178.csv::351.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::352.source_text:
まぁ、いい運動にはなったか
それにしても、王家の墓ともあろう場に
こんなにも魔物がのさばっているとは――
警備に回す人員が不足しているとはいえ、許せないな
178.csv::352.translated_text:
Well, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;twas good exercise at least.
Even so... that the Royal Family Mausoleum should
be so overrun with monsters— Short on guards
though they may be, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;tis unforgivable.
178.csv::352.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::353.source_text:
――ああ、クレス様と指輪の話を
聞きたがっていたのだったね
178.csv::353.translated_text:
—Ah, you wanted to hear of Queen Cress and
the ring, did you not?
178.csv::353.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::354.source_text:
クレス様は、失われた指輪が王家の元に戻れば
その力によってアッカーシェランの一層の繁栄に
繋がるとお考えだったようだ
178.csv::354.translated_text:
Queen Cress believed that should the lost ring
return to the royal house, its power would bring
Acre Selund yet greater prosperity.
178.csv::354.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::355.source_text:
歴代の王たちと共に葬られてはいないかと
二人でこの《王家の墓》の隅々まで探したが
指輪は見つからずじまい――
178.csv::355.translated_text:
We wondered if it might not lie entombed
alongside the kings of old— the two of us
searched every corner of this Royal Family
Mausoleum, yet the ring was ne&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;er found...
178.csv::355.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::356.source_text:
折りを見ては指輪探しの旅に出かけたものの
指輪は見つからぬまま、日々は過ぎ去り――
御子たちが生まれ――
そしてクレス様は竜となられた
178.csv::356.translated_text:
Whenever the chance arose, we&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;d set off on
journeys to find the ring, yet &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;twas was never
found, and the days wore on...
The royal children were born— and Queen
Cress became a Dragon.
178.csv::356.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::357.source_text:
内から炎の力が煌めくような
若くも美しい竜だった
まばゆいほどのその御姿に、これからも
アッカーシェランの繁栄は約束されたと確信したものだ
178.csv::357.translated_text:
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;Twas a Dragon young and beautiful, flame&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s power
shimmering from within.
At that dazzling form, I held the conviction —
Acre Selund&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s prosperity was
assured, now and evermore.
178.csv::357.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::359.source_text:
ふふ、こんな長話をするなんて
私も歳をとったのかもね
今回はここまでにしよう
あのあばら屋でお茶でも飲んでいかないか？
178.csv::359.translated_text:
Hehe, I can’t believe I’ve been rambling on like
this— I guess I’m getting old, too.
Let’s call it a day for now.
Why don’t you come over to that
hovel for a cup of tea?
178.csv::359.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::360.source_text:
今回はここまでにしよう
我があばら屋でお茶でも飲んでいかないか？
今ならなんと――私自ら手摘みした
最高級の茶葉がある
178.csv::360.translated_text:
We&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ll stop here for today.
Will you not stay for tea at my humble abode?
As it happens... I have the finest tea leaves,
picked by my own hand.
178.csv::360.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::361.source_text:
自給自足の生活も案外楽しいものさ
惜しむらくはそれを一緒に楽しみたい相手が
居ないことかな
今日は付き合ってくれるね？
178.csv::361.translated_text:
A self-sufficient life... &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;tis
surprisingly enjoyable.
The pity is... there&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s no one to share it with.
You&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ll keep me company today, will you not?
178.csv::361.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::362.source_text:
指輪が見つからずとも
アッカーシェランの繁栄を確信していた――
しかし、それからすぐのことだ
魔軍の襲撃があったのは
178.csv::362.translated_text:
Though the ring was ne&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;er found, I held
conviction in Acre Selund&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s prosperity— But &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;twas
soon after... the Demon Army attacked.
178.csv::362.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::363.source_text:
ここから先は、すぐには話す気になれない
悪いけど、また今度にしよう
さぁ、お茶の準備をするが
君、茶菓子はどんなものがお好みかな？
178.csv::363.translated_text:
I fear I cannot bring myself to
speak further just yet.
Forgive me, but let us leave it for another time.
Now then, I shall prepare tea.
Tell me, what manner of sweetmeats do you favor?
178.csv::363.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::364.source_text: さぁ、戦おうじゃないか！
178.csv::364.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::365.source_text: 魔道剣を扱うのは素養を持つ、ごく限られた者のみの特権だよ
178.csv::365.translated_text:
The Magick Sword is a privilege reserved for only
those few who possess the aptitude.
178.csv::365.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::366.source_text: ううん、所詮は雑魚の群れ――もっと骨のあるヤツと戦いたいね
178.csv::366.translated_text:
Hmph. Mere small fry, the lot of them — I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;d
rather face aught with more backbone.
178.csv::366.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::367.source_text: 普段は純魔法なんて使う機会が無いからさ
178.csv::367.translated_text:
Normally, I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ve no call to use pure
magick, you see.
178.csv::367.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::368.source_text: やはり二人で戦うというのは良いものだな
178.csv::368.translated_text:
Fighting together like this... &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;tis a
fine thing, indeed.
178.csv::368.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::369.source_text:
ああ、この前の話の続きを聞きに
わざわざ来てくれたのか
君も物好きだな――
せっかくだ、今回も現地で話そうか
178.csv::369.translated_text:
Ah, you came all this way to hear the rest of our
last talk... You&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;re quite the enthusiast. Since
you&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;re here, shall we speak on-site again?
178.csv::369.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::370.source_text:
展望城に通じる秘密の扉
あれがある《王家の隠れ道》に行こう
少々遠いから、支度をしてから向かうよ
先に行っていてくれるかい
178.csv::370.translated_text:
A secret door leading to Lookout Castle.
Let us make for the Royal Family&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s Secret
Path, where it lies.
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;Tis some distance off, so I shall ready
myself afore following.
Will you go on ahead?
178.csv::370.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::371.source_text:
《王家の隠れ道》で待ち合わせよう
少々遠いから、支度をしてから向かうよ
先に行っていてくれるかい
178.csv::371.translated_text:
Let us meet at the Royal Family&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s Secret Path.
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;Tis a fair way off, so I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ll
make ready and follow.
Would you go on ahead?
178.csv::371.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::372.source_text:
では出発といこうか
先ほど言った通り、目的地は秘密の扉だ
いつまた厄介な敵が出てくるとも限らない
二人とはいえ、気を抜かずに行こう
178.csv::372.translated_text:
Then let us be off. As I said, the secret door
awaits. No telling when another troublesome foe
may emerge. Two we may be, but let us
not lower our guard.
178.csv::372.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::374.source_text: 実は、ここにはあまり良い思い出が無くてね
178.csv::374.translated_text:
In truth, I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ve precious few good memories
of this place.
178.csv::374.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::375.source_text:
クレス様――いや、新たな火竜様は
竜力の安定のため、離宮の奥深くや展望城で
静かに過ごしていらっしゃった
178.csv::375.translated_text:
Queen Cress— no, the new Lord Fire Dragon...
spent her days in quiet seclusion deep within the
Detached Palace and at Lookout Castle, for the
stability of the Dragon Force.
178.csv::375.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::376.source_text:
何もかもが平穏で、のどかな毎日だった
そこへ、突然空の歪みと共に黒き竜が現れ――
火竜様ももちろんすぐに戦いに出られた
178.csv::376.translated_text:
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;Twas all peaceful... tranquil days, each one.
Then, of a sudden, the sky warped—and an ebon
wyrm appeared— Lord Fire Dragon, naturally,
sallied forth to battle at once.
178.csv::376.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::377.source_text:
たとえ力及ばずとも、私も
クレス様のお傍で戦いたかった
しかし同時に、彼女自身がそれを望んでいないことも
わかっていたんだ
178.csv::377.translated_text:
Even had I not the strength, I would have fought at Queen Cress&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s side.
But I knew... she herself did not wish for it.
178.csv::377.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::378.source_text:
その望みは、激戦の影響の及ばぬ安全な場に
民を誘導すること――
178.csv::378.translated_text:
Her wish... to guide the people to a haven
beyond the battle&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s reach—
178.csv::378.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::379.source_text:
私は民を誘導することを選んだ
オークを蹴散らし、この《王家の隠れ道》から
彼らを逃がそうとした
178.csv::379.translated_text:
I chose to guide the folk to safety.
Driving back the orcs, I sought to spirit them
away through the Royal Family&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s Secret Path.
178.csv::379.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::380.source_text:
最も、魔軍は同時にいくつもの町を
襲っていたから、今となって思えば
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;安全な場所&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;なんてなかったんだけどね――
178.csv::380.translated_text:
Mind you, the Demon Army fell upon multiple towns
at once, so in hindsight... there was naught such
as a &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;safe place&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;...
178.csv::380.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::381.source_text:
私にとって、ここは――
混乱と後悔の中でひた走った迷宮みたいなものだ
178.csv::381.translated_text:
To me, this place is... much like a labyrinth I
ran blindly through, amidst confusion and regret.
178.csv::381.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::382.source_text:
今回の話はここまでだ
帰るとしようか
いけないね、私の中にまだ後悔があるみたいだ
178.csv::382.translated_text:
This tale ends here.
Shall we return?
...Dear me. Regret still lingers
within me, it seems.
178.csv::382.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::383.source_text:
私はクレス様のハイセプターだ
指示を受けずとも己の意思によって
動くことのできる存在
――王のための存在
178.csv::383.translated_text:
I am Queen Cress&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s High Scepter.
One who moves by her will,
e&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;en without command.
— A being dedicated to the Queen.
178.csv::383.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::384.source_text:
もしも私が共に戦っていれば
クレス様の肉体と力を
悪しき竜の――&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;素材&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;としてなんかに――
使われることだけは無かったかもしれない
178.csv::384.translated_text:
Had I fought alongside her, Queen Cress&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s body
and power... might ne&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;er have been used as the
Evil Dragon&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s... &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;raw materials&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;.
178.csv::384.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::385.source_text:
例えば、クレス様が敗れた瞬間
禁術を用いてでも――この身もろ共
そのお体の一部を吹き飛ばしてしまっていれば――
178.csv::385.translated_text:
For instance, the instant Queen Cress fell— had I
resorted to forbidden arts, blown away a piece of
her form along with this body of mine...
178.csv::385.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::386.source_text:
今でも、あの時のことを夢に見る
クレス様のお傍で共に戦うことと
クレス様のご意思を汲んで動くこと――
178.csv::386.translated_text:
E&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;en now, I dream of that time...
Fighting at Queen Cress&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s side...
And moving in accordance with Her will...
178.csv::386.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::387.source_text: もし君が私なら、どちらを選んだ？
178.csv::387.translated_text: Were you in my stead... which would you choose?
178.csv::387.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::388.source_text: やっぱりね、何かいるとは思ったんだ
178.csv::388.translated_text: As I thought... I suspected aught was here.
178.csv::388.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::389.source_text: ――ここに来るべきじゃなかったかもしれない
178.csv::389.translated_text: ...Perhaps I should not have come here.
178.csv::389.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::390.source_text: 穢れた魔物の分際で、鬱陶しいな
178.csv::390.translated_text: Irksome, for a mere tainted monster.
178.csv::390.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::391.source_text: さっさと殲滅してしまおう、二人ならすぐさ
178.csv::391.translated_text:
Let&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s make short work of them — the two of
us, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;twill be swift.
178.csv::391.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::393.source_text:
先日はすまなかったね
カッコ悪いところを見せてしまった――
178.csv::393.translated_text:
I apologize for the other day.
I fear I showed you an unsightly side of myself—
178.csv::393.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::394.source_text:
今回は――そうだな
君たちがサマラ初代王の指輪を見つけた場所
そこへ行って話したい
178.csv::394.translated_text:
This time— well, then.
The place where you found the
Ring of the First King.
I would go there and speak.
178.csv::394.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::395.source_text:
我々も見付けられなかった指輪の場所
《崩れた進入路》、だったかな
せっかくだ、どんなところなのか興味がある
君の後を追うから、先導してくれるかい
178.csv::395.translated_text:
The ring&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s location, which we
too could not find...
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;Crumbling Entrance Path&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;, was it?
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;Tis a rare chance — I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;m curious what
manner of place it is.
I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ll follow you, so pray, lead the way.
178.csv::395.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::396.source_text:
我々も見付けられなかった指輪の場所
《崩れた進入路》、だったかな
せっかくだ、どんなところなのか興味がある
君の後を追うから、先導してくれるかい
178.csv::396.translated_text:
The ring&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s location, which we
too could not find...
The Crumbling Entrance Path, was it?
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;Tis a rare chance — I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;m curious what
manner of place it is.
I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ll follow you, so pray, lead the way.
178.csv::396.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::397.source_text:
こんなところにあったのか――
見つけられないのも無理はない
我々がこの辺りを調べた時
あの壁は崩れていなかったからな――
178.csv::397.translated_text:
To think it lay in a place like this—
No wonder it could not be found.
When we investigated this area...
That wall had not yet collapsed—
178.csv::397.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::398.source_text:
もしもクレス様と私が見つけていたなら
クレス様は――
いや、今更考えても仕方がないか
178.csv::398.translated_text:
If Queen Cress and I had found it,
Queen Cress would—
...Nay, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;tis no use pondering it now.
178.csv::398.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::399.source_text:
クレス様は、この国の繁栄のためだけでなく
次代の覚者、そして次代の竜となる者
つまり――御子たちのことも思って
指輪を探されていたのだと思う
178.csv::399.translated_text:
I believe Queen Cress sought the ring not merely
for this land&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s prosperity, but with the next
Arisen in mind... and the one who would
become the next Dragon.
In other words — the imperial heirs.
178.csv::399.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::400.source_text:
アッカー家の王位継承者は
王としての重責と、覚者としての定め
その二つを若くして背負うことになるからね
178.csv::400.translated_text:
The heir of House Acre must bear both a ruler&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s
heavy burden and an Arisen&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s destiny,
and at so young an age.
178.csv::400.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::401.source_text:
ん――？　思い出話の最中だというのに
野暮な客のお出ましのようだ
仕方ない、軽くお仕置きしてやろうか
178.csv::401.translated_text:
Hm—? For all our reminiscing, a
boorish guest appears.
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;Tis no matter. Shall I administer
a light chastisement?
178.csv::401.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::402.source_text:
ふふふ、実はさ
覚者である君と一緒に戦っていると
クレス様と共にあった頃を思い出す
何だかそれが嬉しくてね
178.csv::402.translated_text:
Hehe, truth is...
Fighting beside you, an Arisen...
It calls to mind the days I
spent with Queen Cress.
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;Tis strange, but it gladdens me.
178.csv::402.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::404.source_text:
やあ、来たね
指輪のあった場所へ行ってみたいんだ
連れて行ってくれ
――我儘言ってすまないね
178.csv::404.translated_text:
Ah, you&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ve come.
I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;d like to go whither the ring was found.
Take me there.
...Pray, forgive my selfishness.
178.csv::404.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::405.source_text:
その腕前、流石は覚者だ
――覚者といえば、ネド王子も覚者だが
戦いの腕前はどうなんだろうな
178.csv::405.translated_text:
That skill — truly befitting an Arisen.
—Speaking of Arisen, Prince Nedo
is one as well, yet...
I wonder how his battle prowess fares.
178.csv::405.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::406.source_text:
次代の覚者して教育を受けていらした
セラノ姫と違って、ネド王子が
剣を振るっているのを見たことが無いんだ
勉学には励まれていたようだが――
178.csv::406.translated_text:
Unlike Princess Sera, who was educated
as the next Arisen...
I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ve never seen Prince Nedo wield a blade.
He seemed devoted to his studies, but—
178.csv::406.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::407.source_text:
さて、こんなところで長話するのもなんだし
もう観光するものも無い
早めに帰ろうか――君も疲れたろう？
178.csv::407.translated_text:
Well, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;tis no place for a long chat...
There&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s naught left to behold.
Shall we head back early? —You must be weary too?
178.csv::407.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::408.source_text:
さて、こんなところで長話するのもなんだし
もう観光するものも無い
早めに帰ろうか――君も疲れたろう？
178.csv::408.translated_text:
Well, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;tis no place for a long talk. No more
sights to see. Let&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s be off, then —
you must be weary, too.
178.csv::408.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::409.source_text:
――ん？
まだ思い出話が聞きたいのかい
178.csv::409.translated_text: —Hm? Still wish to hear more reminiscences?
178.csv::409.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::410.source_text:
そうだなぁ――
仕えるべき王を失い
次代のハイセプターとして教育する者もいない
私の生に意味は無くなった
178.csv::410.translated_text:
Well now— Having lost the liege I
was bound to serve,
and with no one left to raise as the
next High Scepter...
My life had lost all meaning.
178.csv::410.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::411.source_text:
実家にも戻らず、このあばら屋で
ただ時が過ぎるのを待つ日々だったのは
知っているね？
178.csv::411.translated_text:
You know, don&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;t you? I ne&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;er returned to my
family hearth... simply whiled away the days in
this hovel, waiting for time to pass.
178.csv::411.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::412.source_text:
――だが、君たちがサマラ初代王の指輪を
見つけたと知って――
これは偶然ではないと感じたんだ
178.csv::412.translated_text:
But... when I learned you&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;d found Samara&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s Ring
of the First King...
I felt &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;twas no coincidence.
178.csv::412.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::413.source_text:
アッカーシェランは、黒き竜によって
滅亡の危機に瀕したが
再び立ち上がろうとしている、と
178.csv::413.translated_text:
Acre Selund was driven to the brink of ruin by
the ebon dragon... yet now, it
strives to rise anew.
178.csv::413.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::414.source_text:
それこそが国の意志であり、そこにはきっと
クレス様のお気持ちも含まれるのだろうと
そう強く感じた
178.csv::414.translated_text:
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;Tis the nation&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s will... and I felt strongly
that Queen Cress&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s own heart must
surely lie within it.
178.csv::414.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::415.source_text:
私はこの国のゆく先を見守りたい――
そう願うようになった
178.csv::415.translated_text:
I wish to watch over this land&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s path ahead—
Such a wish has taken root in me.
178.csv::415.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::416.source_text:
君にも、どうか協力してほしいんだ
ネド王子は君を慕っているようだし――
これからも気にかけてやってくれないか？
178.csv::416.translated_text:
I would ask your cooperation as well.
Prince Nedo seems fond of you—
Would you watch over him henceforth?
178.csv::416.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::417.source_text:
――セロとバシアスには私から話を付けておいた
サマラ初代王の指輪は正式に君が持つといい
君なら、必ずその力をアッカーシェランにとっても
いい方向に使ってくれるだろうからね
178.csv::417.translated_text:
...I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ve already spoken with Cyril and Bacias.
The Ring of the First King — &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;tis best
you officially keep it.
You&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ll wield its power for Acre Selund&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s
good, I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ve no doubt.
178.csv::417.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::418.source_text: この程度の相手、私たちの敵では無いさ
178.csv::418.translated_text: Foes of this caliber are no match for us.
178.csv::418.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::419.source_text: ああ、そうそう！　この感覚だ
178.csv::419.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::420.source_text: 君やクレス様と一緒に戦うと、&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;守る&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;といった感じが無いんだよ
178.csv::420.translated_text:
When I fight alongside you and Queen Cress...
there&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s no sense of &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;protecting&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; to be had.
178.csv::420.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::421.source_text: いい腕前だ！　さすがは覚者といったところだね
178.csv::421.translated_text: Fine skill! As expected of the Arisen.
178.csv::421.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::422.source_text: その戦いぶり、ネド王子の指南役に欲しいくらいだ
178.csv::422.translated_text:
That fighting style of yours — &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;tis enow to
make one want you as Prince Nedo&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s instructor.
178.csv::422.speaker: Kirsty

178.csv::423.source_text: こいつが指輪を盗んだ者の成れの果てか？
178.csv::423.translated_text:
Is this the wretch who stole the
ring&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s final fate?
178.csv::423.speaker: Kirsty
